From 3f26bb732cc136ab20176697c92f32c9c84cb125 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wentao Liang <vulab@iscas.ac.cn>
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 09:03:03 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] drm/virtio: fix dma_fence refcount leak on error in
 virtio_gpu_dma_fence_wait()

dma_fence_unwrap_for_each() internally calls dma_fence_unwrap_first()
which does cursor->chain = dma_fence_get(head), taking an extra
reference. On normal loop completion, dma_fence_unwrap_next()
releases this via dma_fence_chain_walk() -> dma_fence_put().

When virtio_gpu_do_fence_wait() fails and the function returns early
from inside the loop, the cursor->chain reference is never released.
This is the only caller in the entire kernel that does an early return
inside dma_fence_unwrap_for_each.

Add dma_fence_put(itr.chain) before the early return.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: eba57fb5498f ("drm/virtio: Wait for each dma-fence of in-fence array individually")
Signed-off-by: Wentao Liang <vulab@iscas.ac.cn>
Reviewed-by: Dmitry Osipenko <dmitry.osipenko@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Osipenko <dmitry.osipenko@collabora.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260607090303.92423-1-vulab@iscas.ac.cn

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/virtio/virtgpu_submit.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/virtio/virtgpu_submit.c
index dae761fa5788..32cb1e4aa425 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/virtio/virtgpu_submit.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/virtio/virtgpu_submit.c
@@ -65,8 +65,10 @@ static int virtio_gpu_dma_fence_wait(struct virtio_gpu_submit *submit,
 
 	dma_fence_unwrap_for_each(f, &itr, fence) {
 		err = virtio_gpu_do_fence_wait(submit, f);
-		if (err)
+		if (err) {
+			dma_fence_put(itr.chain);
 			return err;
+		}
 	}
 
 	return 0;
-- 
2.34.1

### Summary of Modifications

#### File: `drivers/gpu/drm/virtio/virtgpu_submit.c`

- **Modification**: In the function `virtio_gpu_dma_fence_wait()`, a call to `dma_fence_put(itr.chain)` was added inside the error handling block. Previously, when `virtio_gpu_do_fence_wait()` failed and the function returned early from within the `dma_fence_unwrap_for_each` loop, the reference to `iterator.chain` (acquired internally by `dma_fence_unwrap_first`) was not released, causing a dma-fence reference count leak. The new code explicitly puts that reference before the early return.

#### Relationships

- This single-file change fixes a memory/resource leak by ensuring proper cleanup of the fence chain reference on the error path. The modification directly addresses the mismatch between the implicit reference acquisition by the `dma_fence_unwrap_for_each` macro and the missing release when early-exiting the loop. No other files are involved; the fix is self-contained within the virtio-gpu driver’s fence wait logic.

Here is the commit message:
drm/virtio: fix dma_fence refcount leak on error in
 virtio_gpu_dma_fence_wait()

dma_fence_unwrap_for_each() internally calls dma_fence_unwrap_first()
which does cursor->chain = dma_fence_get(head), taking an extra
reference. On normal loop completion, dma_fence_unwrap_next()
releases this via dma_fence_chain_walk() -> dma_fence_put().

When virtio_gpu_do_fence_wait() fails and the function returns early
from inside the loop, the cursor->chain reference is never released.
This is the only caller in the entire kernel that does an early return
inside dma_fence_unwrap_for_each.

Add dma_fence_put(itr.chain) before the early return.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: eba57fb5498f ("drm/virtio: Wait for each dma-fence of in-fence array individually")
Signed-off-by: Wentao Liang <vulab@iscas.ac.cn>
Reviewed-by: Dmitry Osipenko <dmitry.osipenko@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Osipenko <dmitry.osipenko@collabora.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260607090303.92423-1-vulab@iscas.ac.cn

Here is the root cause:
The `dma_fence_unwrap_for_each` macro internally calls `dma_fence_unwrap_first()` which takes an extra reference on `cursor->chain`. On normal loop completion, `dma_fence_unwrap_next()` releases this reference via `dma_fence_chain_walk()`. However, in `virtio_gpu_dma_fence_wait()`, when `virtio_gpu_do_fence_wait()` fails and the function returns early from inside the loop, the `cursor->chain` reference is never released, causing a dma-fence reference count leak.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int virtio_gpu_dma_fence_wait(struct virtio_gpu_submit *submit,
 				     struct dma_fence *fence)
 {
 	struct dma_fence_unwrap itr;
 	struct dma_fence *f;
 	int err;
 
 	dma_fence_unwrap_for_each(f, &itr, fence) {
 		err = virtio_gpu_do_fence_wait(submit, f);
-		if (err)
+		if (err) {
+			dma_fence_put(itr.chain);
 			return err;
+		}
 	}
 
 	return 0;
 }

Reason: When `virtio_gpu_do_fence_wait` fails, the function returns early without releasing the extra reference on `cursor->chain` taken by `dma_fence_unwrap_for_each`. This causes a dma-fence reference count leak.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
- `if (err) { dma_fence_put(itr.chain); return err; }`
Reason: By adding `dma_fence_put(itr.chain)` before the early return, the reference held by the unwrap iterator is properly released, preventing the reference count leak.
